findings.title: Permit the pinned sample set in a paired rerun
findings.disposition: Declined for this run. sample.mts is a one-shot script pinned to the sources and records it measured; relaxing those checks would weaken this evidence. A paired re-run is a new operation that reuses sample-set.json's verse list, re-reads current records and pins its own sources. STATUS now says so.

findings.title: Reclassify s056 (reported twice; one variant also suggested moving s077)
findings.disposition: Accepted for s056: Jeremiah is in the section cast. s077 stays named-not-in-cast: the parable's lord has no cast entry.

findings.title: Mark the Colossae setting (s003) as a grounding error
findings.disposition: Declined as a score change: blind scores are independent judgments under the pre-declared rubric, which does not score unselected settings. Recorded as a rubric limit in the README.

findings.title: Score the uncast figure in s095 / track it as a contract failure (two findings)
findings.disposition: Declined as a score change: U requires a cast entry. Recorded in the README as a rubric limit and as evidence that the planner already depicts uncast generic figures in stored plans.
